name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-tutorial-access-data
title: Access data with the SharePoint REST API and Microsoft Graph
shortDescription: Two Copilot UX components that show the lists on a site with the SharePoint REST API, and the user's profile, mail, and calendar with Microsoft Graph.
longDescription: The finished solution for the article Access data from a Copilot UX component. One declarative agent has two Copilot UX components. SharePointLists uses spHttpClient to show the lists and libraries on a SharePoint site and the items in a selected list. MyProfile uses msGraphClientFactory to show the signed-in user's profile, recent email, and calendar events for the next 7 days.

Both components load data in the view so they render right away with a loading state, show a message when a Microsoft Graph permission isn't approved, and follow the Copilot light and dark themes. All code runs in the browser; the solution package is the only thing to deploy.
